correctness.rationale: Topological iteration of scalar variation of constants gives each directed path exactly once, with positive coefficient ε^(−number of fast edges) times a weighted integral over Δ_k(t); the zero-length path is exact. Rate boundedness makes each phase Lipschitz in the k times uniformly in t. For t≥θ and ε<θ, contraction of the simplex toward a maximizer by ε/t retains volume ε^k/k!, within ε in each coordinate of the maximizer, including at any boundary or multiple maximum. Together with the positive compact feed bounds, each path is sandwiched between c ε^k exp(M/ε) and C ε^(−k) exp(M/ε). A fixed finite positive path sum preserves the uniform O(ε log(1/ε)) estimate. For the example A_x=t²/2−3t, A_y=t²−4t, the feed phase is exactly 1/2−(s−1)²/2. The logarithmic downstream error at t*=2+√(7/2) is ε/2 log(2π/ε)+o(ε), proving class-wide sharpness. Also ε(x+y)'=(t−2)(x+2y); the total is below 1 at t=2 for small ε and strictly increases afterward, crossing once. Taking fixed times on either side of t* with A_x<0 localizes the crossing; the Gaussian tails and initial y contribution are exponentially small there. Setting y=1−x gives A_y(t_ε)+1/2=(ε/2)log(ε/(2π))+o(ε), hence a displacement of order ε log(1/ε) and the stated second-order formula with ℓ*=2√(7/2). The rescaled normalized feed is exactly a conditioned standard Gaussian and its total variation discrepancy is the omitted mass. This proves the limit, not just convergence of simulated moments.
residual_risks: Constant depends on the fixed problem and positive-time cutoff; the claimed estimate is not uniform over different systems or at t=0.

value.rationale: The uniform estimate supplies a usable error scale without smooth crossings, spectral ordering, or favorable initial exponent order. The sharpness witness is motivated by the question whether the logarithmic penalty is only a Jordan phenomenon: a single nondegenerate interior transfer times the departure, yields a half-log prefactor instead of an integer nilpotent depth, and gives a normalized law for when the feed accumulated. Connecting those facts to a specified return level makes the example an informative benchmark rather than a parameter-only exercise.
residual_risks: Practical consequences are confined to fixed finite positive cascades; the example does not establish a generic Gaussian law or feed-time concentration at nonsmooth or boundary optima.
